component.name: ConfTune FC
component.summary: System setup, configuration and performance tuner for Fedora, Rocky Linux, and CentOS

description.p: ConfTune FC is a safety-first configuration, setup, and performance tuning application built specifically for RPM-based Linux distributions, including Fedora Workstation & Server, Rocky Linux, CentOS Stream, AlmaLinux, and RHEL.

Featuring both a modern GNOME Adwaita Dark interface and a headless CLI for remote server administration, ConfTune FC optimizes kernel sysctl parameters, DNF package concurrency, storage TRIM maintenance, CPU power scaling, systemd-oomd memory pressure, and specialized workloads including Docker/Podman, KVM virtualization, and Virtualmin web hosting.

ul.li: Automatic pre-tune snapshots with instant 1-click rollback
Workload presets: Workstation, Gaming low-latency, Server, Database, and Web
Two-tier privilege separation with native PolicyKit (pkexec) elevation
DNF4 and DNF5 multi-threaded download acceleration and mirror optimization
Portable configuration bundles, standalone deploy scripts, and Ansible Playbooks
Fixed label and typography background blending across cards, header bar, and dialogs by enforcing transparent widget backgrounds

description.p: Privilege escalation and GUI presentation release:

ul.li: Integrated proven PolicyKit elevation with asynchronous handshake and XWayland authorization
Fixed action button dimensions and text truncation in Boot and Systemd optimizer
Refined Adwaita Dark styling and status pill badges

description.p: Initial universal production release of ConfTune FC for Fedora, Rocky Linux, and CentOS:

ul.li: 16 specialized GUI views with GNOME 45+ Adwaita Dark styling
Two-tier privilege boundary locking administrative write operations
Ansible Playbook and standalone shell script generators
Full unit test coverage with 112 passing tests
